title: Tiny, cute camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='72' height='48' rx='10' fill='#7BE0FF'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <rect x='14' y='62' width='72' height='18' rx='10' fill='#4FC9EE'/>
  <!-- top bump / viewfinder housing -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='26' height='14' rx='6' fill='#9BEAFF'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='66' y='24' width='14' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFF3A8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='26' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFE04D'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='20' fill='#2E86C1'/>
  <!-- lens mid ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='15' fill='#7BE0FF'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='10' fill='#274B6D'/>
  <!-- lens highlight -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='52' r='4' fill='#A9F2FF'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='61' r='2' fill='#A9F2FF'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='20' y='20' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <!-- little cheeks -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FF9BB0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='48' r='3' fill='#FF9BB0'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='24' y='78' width='14' height='8' rx='4' fill='#4FC9EE'/>
  <rect x='62' y='78' width='14' height='8' rx='4' fill='#4FC9EE'/>
</svg>
